dedupe_keys.name: rocscience geotechnical software suite slide rs2 rs3 settle3 rocfall

description: Rocscience is a commercial suite of geotechnical engineering software for rock and soil. Its products include Slide2 and Slide3 for limit equilibrium slope stability, RS2 and RS3 for finite element analysis of excavations, tunnels and foundations, Settle3 for settlement and consolidation, and RocFall for rockfall simulation, along with other tools for support design and rock mass classification, and an AI assistant called RSInsight. It is produced by Rocscience, a Canadian company whose group also includes DIANA, 3GSM, 2SI, Rockfield and Aquanty. Coverage is global: the tools are used on mine slopes and underground openings, road and rail cuts, tunnels, dams and foundations. The software runs on the desktop under subscription licences, with education licences and free trials, managed through the RocPortal account portal; prices were not shown on the page read. Caveats: it is proprietary, results depend on the site investigation data and constitutive models the user supplies, and the pages read are marketing material. For simulation it provides the slope, excavation and rockfall models used to assess how landslides and earthquakes threaten mines, transport corridors and embankments, and to test stabilisation options. It is related to the GeoStudio record in this catalogue, a competing geotechnical suite.
